audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer text calls Heroic Charge the matchup-defining tool and uses male pronouns for Poppy; the actual lane-decider is Steadfast Presence (W) shutting off Body Slam.
audit.why: Riot text on Poppy W: 'Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.' Gragas E Body Slam is a dash, so her W is a hard denial of his only engage. W cooldown 20/18/16/14/12s; Heroic Charge 14/13/12/11/10s.
audit.corrected: Difficulty is decided by whether her W is live when you press E. Early lane is Poppy's, Level 6 is Gragas's, late is Poppy's again.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart enums contradicted both the packet chart and the whys text: win[0]/phases[0].side said 'Skill' while whys[0] says Poppy out-trades you at Level 1; win[3]/win[4]/win[5] likewise disagreed with the packet chart and their own why text.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Poppy, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Gragas, Skill, Poppy. whys[0] ('Poppy out-trades you at Level 1'), whys[3] ('she keeps trading even'), whys[4] ('Level 6 is yours'), whys[5] ('even at best') all match the packet, not the stored enums.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Poppy / Skill / Poppy / Poppy / Gragas / Skill / Poppy in both layers as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two stated mechanics are wrong and one decisive interaction is entirely absent. (a) Text says Poppy's W 'passively' interrupts dashes and 'stuns' you — the dash-stop is the ACTIVE, and the effect is slow + grounded, not a stun. (b) Nothing anywhere mentions that Keeper's Verdict is a channel and that Gragas's stun or knockback cancels it.
audit.why: Riot text: Poppy W passive is Armor/MR only; the activated component stops dashes and applies slow + grounded. Poppy R is flagged channel ('interruptible — any CC cancels it'), 140/120/100s cooldown. Gragas E (hardCC stun) and R (knockback) are both CC, so either cancels the channel — that is the single highest-value fact for a Gragas player at 6+.
audit.corrected: Bait the W activation, then E; and hold Explosive Cask / Body Slam to cancel Keeper's Verdict rather than spending it on chip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown breakdown carried no numbers at all.
audit.why: Real cooldowns make the advice actionable: Heroic Charge 14/13/12/11/10s, Steadfast Presence 20/18/16/14/12s, Keeper's Verdict 140/120/100s, Explosive Cask 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rewritten with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Poppy's Q carries a 'grounding' derived flag that Riot's own description does not support.
audit.why: Riot text for Hammer Shock: 'swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.' No grounding is described. Per instructions the description wins over a misfiring derived flag, so no advice was written around Q grounding.
audit.corrected: Grounding advice is attributed only to Steadfast Presence, which Riot's text explicitly grounds with.

edits.after: Poppy wins level 1: her W stops Body Slam dead and you have no Happy Hour sustain yet. Last-hit with Barrel Roll from range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Heroic Charge's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Poppy stays ahead through 4-5: her W denies your Body Slam engage, so trade with W-empowered autos and bank Happy Hour sustain instead.

edits.before: Explosive Cask both finishes kills and deletes engages — you choose the fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Poppy's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Level 6 is yours: W-auto into E-Q plus Explosive Cask is a real kill, and the Cask knock also cancels her 140s Keeper's Verdict channel.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Heroic Charge's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker powers your burst, but she buys resistances and W still blocks the engage — even at best.

edits.before: Dodge her E wall-pin — E-Q burst her low damage. Gragas wins by trading around Poppy's Heroic Charge and cashing the pattern: dodge her pin and burst her down.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence (W) stops Body Slam mid-dash and grounds you — bait it, then E-Q. Your knockback also cancels Keeper's Verdict, a 140s channel she cannot get back.

edits.before: Dodge her pin and burst her down. Track Heroic Charge before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Bait Steadfast Presence — 20s at rank 1 — then Body Slam. With her W spent your E stun and Q burst land clean.

edits.after: Barrel Roll poke, W-empowered auto as she steps up, and Body Slam only after Steadfast Presence is spent.

edits.after: Body Slam into her live W — it stops the dash, grounds you, and her E pins you to the wall.

edits.after: Heroic Charge, 14s at rank 1. Fight in open ground while it is down.

edits.before: - Poppy Heroic Charge: matchup-defining — Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Charge: 14/13/12/11/10s — wall-pin stun, so fight in open ground. - Steadfast Presence: 20s at rank 1, and it stops Body Slam. - Explosive Cask, 100s: it cancels her Keeper's Verdict channel.

edits.before: Track Poppy's Heroic Charge: Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. When it is down — E-Q burst her.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence stops Body Slam mid-dash and grounds you; your E stun cancels her R.

edits.before: Poppy's W passive interrupts your Body Slam mid-dash and stuns you, and Heroic Charge pins you to a wall, so she wins the all-in before your kit comes online.
edits.after: Poppy's W is an activated aura, not a passive: with it on, Body Slam is stopped, slowed and grounded, and Heroic Charge then pins you to a wall for the stun.

edits.before: Respect the early levels — this is Poppy's window, not yours. Her W passively interrupts dashes through its aura, so if you open with Body Slam to start a trade she stops your dash, stuns you, and Heroic-Charges you into a wall. At Levels 1-3 you have no Happy Hour sustain until you cast W, and her even auto trades plus a wall-pin out-pace you. Last-hit with Barrel Roll from range, don't fish for the E-stun into her W, and never trade with your back to a wall.
edits.after: Respect the early levels — this is Poppy's window, not yours. Steadfast Presence is an activated aura, not a passive: while it is on, Body Slam is stopped dead and you are left slowed and grounded, and Heroic Charge then walks you into a wall for the stun. At Levels 1-3 you have no Happy Hour sustain until you cast W, and her even auto trades plus a wall-pin out-pace you. Last-hit with Barrel Roll from range, don't fish for the E-stun while her W is live, and never trade with your back to a wall.

notes: Level chart was internally inconsistent: the enum sides disagreed with both the packet chart and the champion's own whys text at rows 0, 3, 4 and 5. Flipped as one atomic group across both layers. Two factual errors corrected: Poppy's dash-stop is her W ACTIVE (not passive) and applies slow + grounded, not a stun. Keeper's Verdict is a channel and any Gragas CC cancels it — that interaction was absent from every field. Poppy's Q carries a 'grounding' derived flag not supported by Riot's description; per the rules I trusted the description and wrote no advice around it. Full-layer text still uses male pronouns for Poppy in several fields I did not edit (enemyWin, breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, report[12].t) — worth a global pronoun pass.
